title: ClimaCuddle® Zipped Baby Romper - Merino Wool & Rayon From Bamboo - Misty Blue - 9-12M
description: Made from our climate-smart ClimaCuddle® fabric, this infant long sleeve romper blends breathable bamboo with temperature-regulating Merino wool to keep your baby cozy in every season. Soft on sensitive skin and designed with a stretchy fit that won’t ride up during tummy time, it keeps your little one comfy all day. ClimaCuddle® climate-smart fabric : 50.8% rayon from bamboo | 49.2% Merino wool Curved double zipper Fold-over cuffs for warmth and scratch protection Flatlock seams for a smooth feel against the skin Breathable underarm gusset Temperature-sensing sticker to guide comfort decisions A personalized embroidered romper adds a unique touch to your baby's moments.
